message.content: A way for a small clinic to remind patients about follow-up appointments without a receptionist chasing everyone by phone.
The chasing is the symptom. What I want to pin down first is which follow-ups actually matter clinically - reminding everyone equally is how these systems get ignored.

description: The other half of presence, and the one state the window exists to produce. An agent genuinely worked this map - its themes and nodes are on the board - but the last thing it did was hours ago, so the 90-second window has long since closed and the header says 'No agent attached' rather than keeping a stale claim alive forever. That honesty is what makes the reattach strip the right thing to show: someone returning to this map does not need the full pitch for attaching an agent, they need a route back in. Read it against 'Mid-exchange', which is the same shape of board with recent agent writes and therefore reads as attached.
